narrative.overview: One 1940s radio set, drawn in two finishes. The tuning dial is the frequency axis of the acoustic link: contracts, shadows, sounding margins, the 2-FSK pair and the live spectrum are all read off one glass scale, and the spectrogram falls beneath it as chart paper on the same axis. Panels are black crackle-finish metal, square 2px corners, a slotted screw in each corner, painted bone-white lettering over a khaki hairline. The projection finish re-values the same tokens in faded khaki with black stencil lettering for a one-screen demo.
keyCharacteristics: Two finishes of one object: bench (default) and projection (one screen, no scroll).
Rust means what this station sends; steel blue means what reaches it; amber glow means live.
Depth comes from recessed windows and a lit glass, not from card shadows.
Three type voices with fixed jobs: League Gothic engraves, Jost explains, Courier Prime counts.

rules.name: The Two Roles Rule
rules.body: Rust is only ever what this station sends; steel is only ever what arrives. Never use either as decoration or as a generic accent.

rules.name: The Only Light Rule
rules.body: Only the dial glass, the paper surfaces and lit lamps are light on the bench finish. A new light surface needs a physical reason (it is a lamp or a sheet of paper).

rules.name: The Lamp Means Live Rule
rules.body: Amber glow marks a live state. A lit lamp that is not carrying state is wrong.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: League Gothic engraves labels, Jost speaks, Courier Prime counts. Do not set sentences in League Gothic or labels in Courier.

rules.name: The Recess Rule
rules.body: Readings go into recessed dark windows; nothing floats on a card.

dos: Do put any frequency-keyed information on the dial's axis (400-4600 Hz) so it lines up with the waterfall below.
Do keep square corners (2px) and a screw in each panel corner.
Do use a pilot lamp rather than a sentence for a binary state; put explanation in a tooltip.
Do define new colours as tokens that .projecao can override, and check both finishes.
Do keep every projection-visible element legible at 1280x720 and 1024x768 without scrolling.
donts: Don't use grey cards, sparklines or soft rounded dashboard widgets.
Don't put rust or steel on anything other than sent or received.
Don't add a light surface that is not glass, paper or a lamp.
Don't put the diary or the bench-only controls (so-bancada) in the projection layout.
Don't use Courier Prime for prose or League Gothic for sentences.
